# pagesift

> The web and document layer for AI agents: any URL, PDF or Office file in, clean Markdown, structured JSON or DataGraph relations out. One self-hosted Rust binary with a CLI, Firecrawl v1/v2 and Jina Reader HTTP APIs, an MCP server, and Python and Node.js packages. Apache-2.0 license.

- Input: URLs (HTTP, or a browser when rendering adds content), HTML, PDF including scanned pages (OCR on CPU or NVIDIA GPU), DOCX, DOC, XLSX, XLS, XLSB, PPTX, PPT, OpenDocument, RTF, WordPerfect, HWP, EPUB, MOBI, FB2, EML, MBOX, MSG, ZIP, TAR, 7Z, images (OCR), SQLite, dBASE, CSV, Markdown and other text formats, 373 code languages as fenced blocks, WARC
- Output: Markdown, HTML, raw HTML, links, images, metadata, schema-based JSON, DataGraph relations & evidence (`graph`); warnings when a result is incomplete
- Install: `cargo install pagesift --locked` · `pip install pagesift` · `npm install @pagesift/node` · `docker run -p 3002:3002 ghcr.io/yolow92/pagesift:1.4.1`
- First call: `pagesift scrape --graph https://example.com` · `pagesift graph inspect ./data/graph.jsonl` · `pagesift.scrape(url).markdown` · `(await new Scraper().scrape(url)).markdown` · `curl localhost:3002/r/https://example.com`
- MCP: `pagesift mcp` (stdio) or `pagesift mcp http --port 3003`; tools `pagesift_scrape`, `pagesift_batch_scrape`, `pagesift_crawl`, `pagesift_poll_job`, `pagesift_cancel_job`, `pagesift_map`, `pagesift_interact`, `pagesift_interact_stop`, `pagesift_graph_query`, and with a configured model `pagesift_agent`, `pagesift_agent_status`
- Not for: standalone image files (OCR covers scanned pages inside PDFs)

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install, examples, capabilities, performance, architecture
- [File upload API](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/parse-api.md): `POST /v2/parse`, parsers and OCR modes
- [Structured extraction](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/structured-extract.md): schemas, selector memory and relocation
- [Agent API](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/agent-api.md): `POST /v2/agent`
- [Browser sessions](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/interact.md): `keepSession` and `/interact`
- [Monitoring](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/monitor.md): `/v2/monitor`
- [Jina Reader compatibility](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/jina-reader.md): `/r/` and `/s/` headers
- [Shared MCP service](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/mcp-service.md): one local MCP server for every agent on a machine
- [Architecture](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md): methods, datasets and results against other tools
- [Example config](https://github.com/YOLOW92/pagesift/blob/main/docs/pagesift.example.toml)
